research_feedback: The strongest reusable training pattern is evidence-scope discrimination: teach the model to preserve a useful component capability while refusing promotion of a larger unsupported claim.
Negative executable evidence should be trained as a first-class signal, not as noise to be overwritten by later source success.

The measured XENO/Qwen package localizes the current target to contextual semantic-to-symbol binding/routing; retraining semantic readout, writeout or carrier algebra as primary objectives would spend capacity on already-measured strengths.
Geometry examples must teach centering/anisotropy control and distinguish measured low-rank usefulness from universal rank claims.

Future exact-model rows should combine this evidence-safety layer with the dynamic S3 opaque-code binding layer only after exact accepted ABI atoms and tokenizer identity are rendered and holdouts remain ancestry-isolated.
Forge/Distillery acceptance is the next dataset reality gate: candidate JSONL quality alone must never be conflated with accepted_dataset_tokens > 0.
